primary: independent complete coverage and deadline-restricted whole-task time
rules: All four arms get identical episode inputs and collection authority within case. No shared model response or cached grade.
First block is a development diagnosis, eight arms total. No significance testing on two scenes. Never retry a dispatched arm as a clean new sample.
If the shared endpoint fails before a usable response, halt further dispatch to that endpoint for diagnosis; continue independent replay. Do not expand if comparisons fail the research gates.
Second repeat block and independent tests require first block review for actual valid mechanism opportunities and endpoint stability; do not pool across code versions.
rounds: 1 joint compile, strict evidence transfer, scoped authority and original controller restoration
2 branchwise progress and re-planning with candidate costs; compare independent finite reference
3 only for a reproduced remaining defect; otherwise close route with decision report
